notes.title: SIGNALIS:MEMORIES ALBUM RELEASED & OST CD PRE-ORDER
notes.content:
SIGNALIS:MEMORIES Side A & B Out Now on Bandcamp & Streaming

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37297831/29bfadefe0257fbd356946102d9cde91c71db1c0.png
Out now as digital download and available on major streaming platforms, SIGNALIS:MEMORIES is a collection of 14 beautiful re-imaginations of some of 1000 Eyes' favorite tracks composed for SIGNALIS.

SIGNALIS: MEMORIES (Side A)  & SIGNALIS: MEMORIES (Side B) on bandcamp
SIGNALIS: MEMORIES (Side A) & SIGNALIS: MEMORIES (Side B)  on Spotify
SIGNALIS: MEMORIES (Side A) & SIGNALIS: MEMORIES (Side B) on Apple Music
Full Album on Youtube (Official) 

SIGNALIS ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK on Compact Disc up for Pre-Order

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37297831/9eab0fd01406722b5958537b20c7005a2fa68659.png
Until June 13th 2025, the SIGNALIS Original Soundtrack by Cicada Sirens & 1000 Eyes is available for pre-order as a 2-Disk CD set, featuring album design by rose-engine.

Very OK Vinyl (Ships from Canada)
Black Screen Records (Ships from Germany)
Materia Store (Ships from USA)
The Yetee (Ships from USA)

This 2-CD set contains the full OST for the game, as well as four new remixed tracks from 1000 Eyes and Cicada Sirens. Presented in a transparent jewel case with white print, featuring a full color cardboard O-card sleeve.

notes.title: L* BETRIEBSYSTEM PATCH 1.2.1
notes.content:
SIGNALIS Version PC-Steam 1.2.1 "KRÄHE" R-42
This patch adds native support for DualShock 4 and DualSense controllers on PC.
Added adaptive trigger effects for DualSense controllers. The intensity of the effect can be adjusted in the settings.ini file of your profile by editing the "adaptivetriggers" value (default 0.5).
Various small bugfixes.

notes.title: L* BETRIEBSSYSTEM UPDATE 1.2 "KRÄHE"
notes.content:
SIGNALIS Version PC-Steam 1.2 "KRÄHE" R-33

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37297831/fe0f51b6f63da4948428499ec0cae35cf3882608.gif
Added an option to adjust the inventory capacity.
By default, the Flashlight Module and Eidetic Module will no longer take up an inventory slot. This behavior can be toggled in the settings from the main menu.
Added an option to extend the inventory size.
Added an option to invert Y-axis in first person scenes.
Added an input scheme for AZERTY-style keyboards.
Added an option to reduce some high-frequency flickering visual effects.
Added an option to allow using health items while at full health to dispose of them.
Improved interaction angles for hole jumping and ladder climbing interactions.
Minor balancing adjustments across all difficulty settings.
Various small bugfixes.

notes.title: L* BETRIEBSSYSTEM UPDATE 1.1 "SPATZ"
notes.content:
SIGNALIS Version PC-Steam 1.1 "SPATZ" R-15
This patch primarily addresses rare, game-breaking bugs in multiple puzzles throughout the game.
Fixed Resolution, Refresh Rate and CRT mode settings not loading correctly on game startup.
Improved interaction angles and cooldowns in top-down view.
Fixed multiple small asset errors throughout the game.
Small performance optimizations.
Minor balancing adjustments.
